sections.text_helper: Section 40.5.4 "Lane merger" in chapter 40 (CSI-2 Host (CSI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2020.
sections.section_content:
Applications requiring more bandwidth than the one provided by a single data lane may
expand the data path to more lanes in order to increase the attainable data rate. The lane
merger supports then up to two data lanes.
The lane merger module converts the D-PHY_RX PPI protocol into a byte-oriented bus to
be sent to the LLP.
The lane merger parallelizes the bytes to 32 bits in parallel to build a 32-bit output as shown
in the figures below. Thecycle number does not account for module internal latency.
[Figure 420. Lane merger input and output (one data lane)]
[Figure 421. Lane merger input and output (two data lanes)]
LANENB[2:0] in CSI_LMCFGR configures the number of data lanes used in the application.
The software needs to map the physical data lanes input to the lane merger logical data
lanes, using DL0MAP[2:0] and DL1MAP[2:0] as shown in the figure below.
